description: API routes + coach tool integration. Exposes the FEAT-001 suggestRoute service through POST /api/routes/suggest, GET /api/routes/[id], GET /api/routes?plannedSessionId=, and PATCH /api/profile/home-location, adds the suggestRoute typed coach tool to buildCoachTools (gotcha #36 schema rules), and updates the coach system prompt. Depends on FEAT-001 (service + types must exist).
steps: Create app/src/app/api/routes/suggest/route.ts: export const runtime='nodejs' + a bounded maxDuration (e.g. 30). Auth via createClient() + supabase.auth.getUser() (401 if none). Parse JSON body {distanceKm, terrain, coord?, placeText?, browserCoord?, plannedSessionId?}. If plannedSessionId present, verify ownership (RLS select on planned_sessions by id + user_id; 404 if not owned). Call suggestRoute(supabase, user.id, opts) -> NextResponse.json({route}). Catch and map sentinels via orsErrorResponse (incl NO_LOCATION->422). Follow the JSON {error} + status shape from api/integrations/strava/activities/route.ts.

Create app/src/app/api/routes/[id]/route.ts: GET, params typed Promise<{id:string}> then await (mirror api/activities/[id]/route.ts). Auth; select one suggested_routes row by id + user_id (RLS owner-scoped); 404 if missing; return the row.

Create app/src/app/api/routes/route.ts: GET honoring ?plannedSessionId=; auth; owner-scoped select from suggested_routes (optionally filtered by planned_session_id), ordered created_at DESC; return {routes}.

Create app/src/app/api/profile/home-location/route.ts: PATCH, runtime='nodejs'. Auth; parse {home_lat, home_lng, home_label}; server-validate (lat -90..90, lng -180..180, label trimmed + length-capped, allow null to clear); update profiles for user.id (RLS-scoped); return the saved fields.

Add the suggestRoute tool to buildCoachTools in app/src/lib/ai/tools/index.ts. inputSchema EXACTLY per gotcha #36: distanceKm z.number().nullable().default(null); terrain z.enum(['flat','uphill']).nullable().default(null); place z.string().nullable().default(null). NO .min/.max/.uuid. execute: clamp distanceKm to 1..60 (default ~8 when null), default terrain 'flat', resolve location server-side via the suggestRoute service (place -> home -> last activity; NO browserCoord in chat), return a CONCISE summary {distance, requestedDistance, terrain, ascent, startLabel, note} (NOT geometry). On NO_LOCATION return {needsLocation:true, message:'Ask the athlete where they want to run.'} — NEVER throw. Export suggestRoute from the buildCoachTools return object.

Update app/src/lib/ai/tools/index.test.ts: add 'suggestRoute' to EXPECTED_TOOLS; add a gotcha-#36 regression test asserting the schema safeParses the all-omitted model payload (-> all null) and that execute returns needsLocation (not a throw) when location is unresolved (stub the service / supabase so it is deterministic and offline).

Update app/src/lib/ai/prompts/coach.ts: add suggestRoute to the Tool Usage Guidelines list and a short 'Suggesting routes' subsection — use suggestRoute for route asks; read back distance/ascent/terrain honestly INCLUDING requested-vs-actual; MAY describe terrain qualitatively but MUST NOT invent named landmarks the data didn't provide (gotcha #23); if the tool returns needsLocation, ask the athlete where they want to run.
acceptance_criteria: The four API route files exist, all declare runtime='nodejs', all authorize via supabase.auth.getUser(), and all are owner/RLS-scoped. /api/routes/suggest maps ORS/NO_LOCATION sentinels via orsErrorResponse.

buildCoachTools returns a suggestRoute tool whose schema uses .nullable().default(null) (no .optional/.min/.max/.uuid) and whose execute clamps distance and returns needsLocation instead of throwing when unresolved.
app/src/lib/ai/tools/index.test.ts EXPECTED_TOOLS includes 'suggestRoute' and the regression test passes.
coach.ts prompt references suggestRoute with the honesty + no-invented-landmarks guidance.
cd app && npm run build passes and cd app && npm run test passes (incl. the tool wiring + schema regression tests).
findings:
DONE. Build passes; all 66 tests pass (index.test.ts now 7 tests incl. the two new suggestRoute gotcha-#36 regressions). All four API routes register in the build output. Staged only this feature's files; committed locally (never pushed).

=== FILES ADDED/CHANGED ===
NEW: app/src/app/api/routes/suggest/route.ts (POST), app/src/app/api/routes/route.ts (GET list), app/src/app/api/routes/[id]/route.ts (GET one), app/src/app/api/profile/home-location/route.ts (PATCH). CHANGED: app/src/lib/ai/tools/index.ts (suggestRoute tool), app/src/lib/ai/tools/index.test.ts (EXPECTED_TOOLS + 2 regression tests), app/src/lib/ai/prompts/coach.ts (guidance).

=== API CONTRACTS FEAT-003 (UI) MUST USE ===
All routes: runtime='nodejs', self-authorize via supabase.auth.getUser() (401 if no user), owner/RLS-scoped. Call from the client via the http() wrapper (gotcha #18), not raw fetch. Next 16 dynamic params are a Promise (already handled server-side).

POST /api/routes/suggest
  Request JSON body: { distanceKm: number (required, clamped 1..60 server-side), terrain?: 'flat'|'uphill' (default 'flat'), coord?: {lng:number,lat:number}|null (explicit start, highest priority), browserCoord?: {lng:number,lat:number}|null (navigator.geolocation — MUST be lng-first: convert with fromGeolocation(pos) from @/lib/integrations/ors/geo before sending), placeText?: string|null (geocoded), plannedSessionId?: string|null (ownership-verified; 404 if not owned) }.
  Success 200: { route: RouteResult } where RouteResult = { routeId:string, requestedDistanceM:number, distanceM:number, ascentM:number, descentM:number, terrain:'flat'|'uphill', bbox:[minLng,minLat,maxLng,maxLat], geometry:{type:'LineString',coordinates:number[][]} (lng-first, 3D [lng,lat,ele]), elevationProfile:{distM:number,eleM:number}[], start:{lng:number,lat:number,label:string|null} }.
  Errors: 400 {error} (bad JSON / non-positive distanceKm), 401 {error} (unauth), 404 {error} (plannedSessionId not owned), else sentinels mapped by orsErrorResponse → 422 NO_LOCATION ('I need a start location…'), 422 ORS_NO_ROUTE, 429 ORS_RATE_LIMITED, 500 ORS_UNAUTHORIZED (owner must set ORS key), 504 ORS_TIMEOUT, 502 ORS_UNAVAILABLE, 500 fallback. All error bodies are { error: string }.

GET /api/routes?plannedSessionId=<uuid> (query optional)
  Success 200: { routes: SuggestedRoute[] } — full DB rows (snake_case: id, user_id, planned_session_id, requested_distance_m, distance_m, ascent_m, descent_m, terrain, start_lat, start_lng, start_label, geometry, elevation_profile, bbox, created_at, updated_at), newest first. Empty → { routes: [] }.

GET /api/routes/[id]
  Success 200: { route: SuggestedRoute } (full snake_case row). 404 {error:'Not found'} if missing/not owned.

PATCH /api/profile/home-location
  Request JSON body: { home_lat: number|null, home_lng: number|null, home_label: string|null }. Rules enforced server-side: lat -90..90, lng -180..180, home_lat & home_lng must be set-or-cleared TOGETHER (400 otherwise), home_label trimmed + capped at 120 chars (empty→null). Pass null to clear a field.
  Success 200: { home_lat, home_lng, home_label } (the saved values, number|null / string|null). Errors: 400 {error} (validation), 401 {error}, 500 {error}.

=== COACH SUMMARY FIELD NAMES (chat tool) ===
The suggestRoute tool's execute returns a CONCISE summary object (NOT geometry), for the model to read back: { distance:string (formatDistance of distanceM), requestedDistance:string (formatDistance of requestedDistanceM), terrain:'flat'|'uphill', ascent:string ('<n> m'), startLabel:string, note:string }. On unresolved location it returns { needsLocation:true, message:string } (never throws). On ORS/other failure: { error:string }. The RouteResult→summary mapping: distance←distanceM, requestedDistance←requestedDistanceM, ascent←ascentM, terrain←terrain, startLabel←start.label. UI should render the FULL RouteResult/SuggestedRoute (geometry, elevationProfile, bbox) — the chat summary is model-facing only.

=== NOTES ===
Mastra 1.78 createTool execute signature is (inputData, context) — first positional arg IS the parsed input (confirmed in @mastra/core types.d.ts line ~426/438). The suggestRoute tool uses NO browserCoord (chat can't geolocate) — resolution is place → home → last run. For the UI map feature, DO send browserCoord to the POST route to honour 'use my current location'.
